summary: Complete testing of LowKey inbox, friends, and lounges functionality. Fixed variable shadowing bug in /api/friends/accept endpoint. All 15 backend tests passed. All 15 features verified working: Login, GET /api/lounges returns lounges including auto-seeded ones (LowKey Lounge, Kink Lounge, VIP Lounge), GET /api/lounges?afterDark=true returns After Dark, auto-seeding ensures all 4 required lounges exist, home page shows all 4 featured lounges, POST /api/friends/request creates friend requests, GET /api/friends/requests/{userId} returns pending requests, POST /api/friends/accept accepts friend requests (FIXED), GET /api/inbox?userId={userId} returns conversations, POST /api/conversations creates conversations, POST /api/inbox/{convoId}/messages sends messages, GET /api/inbox/{convoId}/messages returns messages, inbox page loads at /inbox, profile page Connect button works, lounge cards route to /lounge?id=X (NOT /search).
seed_data_creation: Created test user testfriend@test.com for friend request testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: All inbox, friends, and lounges functionality tested and working. Fixed variable shadowing bug in /api/friends/accept endpoint (line 1620: changed 'const request' to 'const friendReq' to avoid shadowing the function parameter). Auto-seeding ensures 4 required lounges exist (LowKey Lounge, After Dark, Kink Lounge, VIP Lounge). Inbox routes: GET /api/inbox?userId=X returns conversations, GET /api/inbox/{convoId}/messages returns messages, POST /api/inbox/{convoId}/messages sends messages. Friend routes: POST /api/friends/request, GET /api/friends/requests/{userId}, POST /api/friends/accept. Profile page shows Connect button for non-friends and Message button for friends (requires fresh login to see updated friends list).
